title: coldluau.toml
description: Configuration for coldluau, a fast Luau preprocessor: aliases to Roblox-native string requires, and more.

profile.description: Per-environment overlays selected with --profile <name>. Tables deep-merge per key; arrays and scalars are replaced whole. (M2)

aliases.description: Require aliases. Optional: .luaurc aliases work with zero config; entries here merge over them per key. Values are @game/... DataModel paths or filesystem paths. "@self" and "@game" are reserved.

additionalProperties.description: A DataModel path ("@game/ReplicatedStorage/packages") or a filesystem path ("./Packages/signal").

process.description: What to read, where to write, how to print.

generator.description: Output printer. retain-lines preserves formatting, comments, and line numbers. dense/readable land in M2.

quotes.description: Quote style for require strings in the output. preserve keeps whatever the source used, double/single requote every require string and generated instance expression.

requires.description: The require-rewriting transform. Input semantics are always Luau-RFC "luau" mode.

target.description: roblox-string: native @game/./@self string requires. path: relative filesystem paths (Lune). roblox-instance: Instance expressions like script.Parent:FindFirstChild("x") (see indexing_style).

sourcemap.description: Optional Rojo sourcemap.json to sharpen the DataModel mapping. (M2)

mounts.description: Fallback filesystem->DataModel mapping; rarely needed with a Rojo project file. Keys are directories relative to the project root.

strict.description: Upgrade warn-level classes (missing target file, case mismatch) to errors. Unknown aliases and inexpressible/realm-violating requires are ALWAYS errors.

overrides.description: Per-path target overrides (glob -> target), e.g. instance requires for early-replication client code. (M2)

indexing_style.description: roblox-instance target only: how emitted Instance chains index children. find_first_child -> :FindFirstChild("x"), wait_for_child -> :WaitForChild("x"), property -> .x (the dot format). Kebab-case spellings are accepted too.

rojo.description: Rojo project integration: auto-derived mounts and the derived build project in .coldluau/.

build_project.description: Override the derived build project location (default: <cache_dir>/build.project.json).

defines.description: Compile-time constants, injected as globals and constant-folded. Override per profile for dev/release builds. (M2)

rule.description: false = off (default), true = on, or a table with rule options and per-rule file filters (apply_to/skip globs).

rules.description: Builtin transforms, all off by default. Every darklua rule name is accepted so configs port over 1:1. Rules that are not implemented yet error at load time naming their milestone. darklua's convert_require lives in [requires], inject_global_value in [defines], remove_spaces in the dense generator.

const_requires.description: coldluau only. Turn `local X = require(...)` into `const X = require(...)`. Skips multi bindings and annotated locals. Implemented.

remove_comments.description: Remove comments. `true`, or a table with `except` regexes for comments to keep (defaults to ["^--!"] so Luau directives survive; set [] to match darklua). Implemented.

append_text_comment.description: Insert a comment at the start or end of every file. Implemented.

text.description: Literal comment text, mutually exclusive with file

file.description: Read the comment text from this file

add_luau_directive.description: coldluau only. Write a Luau directive at the top of every file, ex: "strict" emits --!strict. An existing directive of the same family is left alone. Implemented.

compute_expression.description: Fold side effect free expressions to their result. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

convert_function_to_assignment.description: function foo() end becomes foo = function() end. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

convert_index_to_field.description: t['field'] becomes t.field. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

convert_local_function_to_assign.description: Non recursive local function f becomes local f = function(). Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

convert_luau_number.description: Binary literals become hex, digit separators stripped. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

convert_square_root_call.description: math.sqrt(x) becomes x ^ 0.5. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

filter_after_early_return.description: Drop statements after a do block that always returns. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

group_local_assignment.description: Merge consecutive local statements. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

make_assignment_local.description: Luau const declarations become local (the inverse of const_requires). Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_assertions.description: Remove assert() calls. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_attribute.description: Remove Luau function attributes like @native. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_compound_assignment.description: x += 1 becomes x = x + 1. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_continue.description: Rewrite continue into repeat until true with a flag. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_debug_profiling.description: Remove debug.profilebegin and debug.profileend calls. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_empty_do.description: Remove empty do end blocks. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_floor_division.description: a // b becomes math.floor(a / b). Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_function_call_parens.description: print('x') becomes print'x'. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_if_expression.description: if c then a else b becomes c and a or b. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_interpolated_string.description: Backtick strings become string.format calls. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_method_call.description: obj:m(x) becomes obj.m(obj, x). Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_method_definition.description: function C:m() becomes function C.m(self). Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_nil_declaration.description: Drop trailing nil values from local declarations. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_types.description: Remove all Luau type syntax. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_unused_if_branch.description: Remove statically decidable if branches. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_unused_variable.description: Remove unused locals and local functions. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

remove_unused_while.description: Remove while loops whose condition is statically false. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

rename_variables.description: Rename locals and params to short names. Not implemented yet, lands in M2.

extensions.description: User-defined transformers written in Luau, sharing the fused traversal with builtin rules. (M3)

path.description: Luau module returning { name, filter, visit }.

before.description: Run before this builtin rule instead of after all rules.

bundle.description: Single-file bundling with deterministic module-init ordering. Present = enabled. (M3)

tree_shake.description: Drop modules unreachable from the entry point.

loaders.description: Data files required as modules are converted to Lua tables (glob -> loader).

trace_map.description: Emit a mapping file for stack-trace deobfuscation.

disallow_unused_modules.description: Files unreachable from any entry point.

realm_analysis.description: Error when client-reachable code requires server-only containers.

early_require_diagnostics.description: Flag string requires reachable from early client entry points (no wait semantics).

native_expressible.description: Flag emitted requires that can't be native string form.
